confidence_notes: Beer, coffee and inexpensive-meal anchors are the most consistent across the aggregate Orlando price indexes and listings I found, which differ by roughly 10-20%. The midrange meal is moderately consistent. Cocktail and wine are lower confidence: the cocktail figure synthesises sparse bar and menu data, and the wine figure is a judgement from happy-hour and upscale menus, cross-checked against the beer anchor. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for July peak season and were not checked against live listings. The FX observation needed a second RBA lookup because the first search returned no verified rate.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city used. Food and drink anchors rest on Orlando-specific aggregate price indexes and venue listings. Accommodation anchors rest on model knowledge of Orlando's summer tourist lodging market.
